text: For the seat that holds meta_agent/src/designer.py (I did not touch it). Two things changed under it in c95b43a: template.SOURCE is now template_v2, so designer.run builds from agent@79909cd133f1 (v1 and agent@21f0dd569975 stay; test_designer passes unchanged), and bundle.compose takes two optional arguments, skills=catalogue.take(["<id>@v<n>", ...]) and subagents=[{name, description, skills, side_effects}], and fills the Subagents section itself. What the designer still needs before a request can be built with skills, and is yours: run() passes one tool (intake["tool_contract"]) and no skills; a rheometer bundle needs several tools and the drawing. The mapping I used is build_rheo_bundle in meta_agent/tests/test_skills.py, on meta_agent/tests/fixtures/rheometer/bundle/intake.json. Where the drawing lives on the spec waits for the design role (my ask 20261109-meta-macbook-20261109-2-1).
